name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWE.eval_difference
title: Two BGG+ encodings under one key: the evaluated difference is a BGG+ encoding of the secret difference with the evaluated error difference
statement: If c1_i = s1(A_i - x_i G) + e1_i and c2_i = s2(A_i - x_i G) + e2_i (same matrices, same attribute x), then for every circuit f, EvalCt(f, c1) - EvalCt(f, c2) = (s1 - s2)(A_f - f(x) G) + e_f where e_f is the BGG+ evaluated error of the input error differences e1_i - e2_i. So the error difference after homomorphic evaluation is a fixed public linear image of the input error difference, independent of the secrets.
